- Confirm that the attached checklist and timeline align with Redwood's pre-PIP expectations and any legal considerations.
- Guidance on documentation language we should use in the 1:1 message to keep this constructive and non-punitive.
- Any records retention notes or required participants for the first checkpoint (people partner + manager?).

- 30-day documented coaching window starting next Monday (6/14).

Marcus — tagging you to confirm you’re aligned with the escalation threshold here.

I can circulate the manager->employee note once HR signs off on tone and docs.

Thanks,

Karthik —

Thanks for the detailed packet. I reviewed the readout and the draft checklist. High-level HR guidance below:

1) Tone and framing: keep all employee-facing language focused on support, resources, and clear expectations. Avoid phrasing that implies punishment (e.g., "failure to improve" is better framed as "if agreed expectations are not met, we will consider next steps, which may include a formal performance plan").

2) Documentation: please use a private Google Doc for each checkpoint and link to the employee's HR file. Include date, attendees, agreed actions, and measurable criteria.

3) Participants: first check-in should include the manager and the employee; cc the People Partner (Stephanie) on the follow-up notes. If accommodations are requested, loop in People Ops.

4) Timeline: 30 days is reasonable. Recommend weekly written summaries (2–3 bullets) + one coaching action item each week.

5) Legal/retention: keep the original emails in case of future review. Send any final decision emails from your Redwood address so HR can archive appropriately.

I made a few inline comments in coaching-checklist.xlsx and attached a redlined PDF to my response (readout-summary_redline.pdf). I also recommend using the following neutral sentence in the opening manager message: "This is a documented coaching plan to clarify expectations and make space for focused support — our goal is to help you succeed."

If you want, Stephanie and I can join the first one-on-one as an observer.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: readout-summary_redline.pdf

Dylan —

Following our verbal conversation, this email documents the coaching plan we agreed to. Laura and Stephanie are cc'd per HR practice. Please reply to confirm receipt.

Summary:
- Purpose: A 30-day focused coaching window to align on measurable expectations and provide hands-on support.
- Start: 14 Jun 2027; End review: 14 Jul 2027.
- Weekly cadence: 30-min syncs on Mondays at 10am (first on 21 Jun due to calendars) + written 2–3 bullet summary after each check-in.
- Goals (examples from checklist):
  1) Complete code reviews within 48 hours for critical PRs (target >90% on-time).
  2) Respond to cross-team Slack mentions within 8 business hours.
  3) Deliver the feature X milestone by 7/7 with unit tests and integration notes.
- Support offered:
  - Pairing sessions and calendar blocks for deep work.
  - Weekly 1-hour focused pairing with me for backlog prioritization.
  - Access to training materials and an observable checklist (attached).
- Success criteria: quantitative improvement on the measurable items above and positive feedback from two cross-team leads.
- If we do not see improvement by 14 Jul, we will meet with Laura to determine next steps which could include formal performance processes.

Please see attached coaching-checklist.xlsx and dylan-weekly-examples.txt for the incidents and baseline data.

Thanks — I'm here to help. Reply to acknowledge and share any concerns you want added to the plan.

Karthik
